spelling_policy: Only explicit per-item forms are accepted. For W20 Q34, judgement/judgment and their explicitly listed two-word phrases are accepted British/American variants. No general hyphen deletion, stemming or fuzzy synonym rule.
normalisation: Trim outer whitespace; collapse internal whitespace; Unicode casefold. No fuzzy spelling, automatic article deletion, plural stemming or unit deletion. Clock/numeric variants are explicit. Choice letters are case-insensitive. Two-choice items are unordered sets scored by distinct intersection.

questions.prompt: What can the leader conclude about a participant?

options.A: A general weakness from attendance alone
options.B: A complete error profile from a total
options.C: Only observations supported by the available records

questions.explanation: The leader distinguishes an observation from its possible cause; a settled explanation is not guaranteed.

questions.prompt: What should happen to unanswered spaces?

options.B: Preserve them in the first response
options.C: Copy the corrected version over them

questions.explanation: The original blanks remain; later recollections and corrections are separate.

questions.prompt: What should the opening review begin with?

options.A: A permanent label for the learner
options.B: The first response compared with the stated requirement
options.C: A guessed cause for every error

questions.explanation: An observable response is examined before interpreting its cause.

questions.prompt: If the earlier response is missing, participants should

options.B: use a fictional example as personal evidence
options.C: record the gap and plan appropriate collection

questions.explanation: Fictional examples can demonstrate a method but cannot establish a personal error pattern.

questions.prompt: Before comparing scores, the group should

options.A: check and consistently apply the stated scoring rule
options.B: award two points for a repeated correct letter
options.C: silently change ambiguous rules for one participant

questions.explanation: Scoring rules and ambiguities must be visible; duplicates do not earn another point.

questions.prompt: How should shared responses be identified?

options.B: By changing the code on each page
options.C: By a consistent code linking the relevant records

questions.explanation: A consistent code connects pages without unnecessary identifying details.

questions.prompt: What makes the closing plan appropriate?

options.A: Giving every participant the same weakness
options.B: Choosing an action or evidence collection justified by the record
options.C: Treating one error as a permanent inability

questions.explanation: The next step depends on actual evidence and may be collection rather than remediation.

questions.prompt: At the END of this exchange, who supports: Selecting one observed error pattern as the next focus?
questions.explanation: Final stance: Iris only. Ignore an initial proposal if later withdrawn; the tutor is not an answer option.

questions.prompt: At the END of this exchange, who supports: Preserving the first response before annotation?
questions.explanation: Final stance: Both students. Ignore an initial proposal if later withdrawn; the tutor is not an answer option.

questions.prompt: At the END of this exchange, who supports: Recording time spent reading the instruction in the next trial?
questions.explanation: Final stance: Owen only. Ignore an initial proposal if later withdrawn; the tutor is not an answer option.

questions.prompt: At the END of this exchange, who supports: Classifying every blank as carelessness?
questions.explanation: Final stance: Neither student. Ignore an initial proposal if later withdrawn; the tutor is not an answer option.

questions.prompt: At the END of this exchange, who supports: Using a fresh task for the very next check?
questions.explanation: Final stance: Iris only. Ignore an initial proposal if later withdrawn; the tutor is not an answer option.

questions.prompt: At the END of this exchange, who supports: Keeping more than one plausible explanation in the record?
questions.explanation: Final stance: Both students. Ignore an initial proposal if later withdrawn; the tutor is not an answer option.
